name: Barbell bench press

phases.name: lower
phases.cue: Lower the bar to your lower chest

phases.name: pause
phases.cue: Touch the chest and stay tight

phases.name: press
phases.cue: Press up and back over your shoulders

formTips: Lie with your eyes under the bar and your feet flat on the floor
Grip just wider than your shoulders and pinch your shoulder blades together
Lower the bar under control to your lower chest, elbows about 45–70° from your body
Press the bar up and slightly back until it's over your shoulders
Keep your glutes, shoulders and head on the bench the whole set
commonMistakes: Bouncing the bar off the chest
Flaring the elbows straight out to the sides
Lifting the hips off the bench
Stopping the bar well above the chest
